Quinoa cucumber salad

Original EZEATS recipe · editorially reviewed draft · owner review required · not kitchen-tested.

Cooled quinoa and chickpeas carry a fresh lemon-parsley dressing.

Mediterranean-inspired · lunch, salad · easy

Servings: 2

Prep: 10 min

Cook: 20 min

Total: 30 min (estimate)

Estimated cost: USD 5 per serving. Not a price quote or a CAD conversion.

Diet and allergy suitability: unverified. Ingredient-list screening only, for the exact products specified. Brands, substitutions and cross-contact can change suitability. Editorial review is not kitchen testing or a medical or allergy-safety guarantee.

Known allergens: No listed major allergens. This list may be incomplete; check package labels and cross-contact.

Before you cook

  • Before starting, wash hands with soap and water for 20 seconds. Rinse fresh produce under running water and use clean utensils.
  • Check every packaged ingredient label for dietary requirements and allergens, including cross-contact notices. Choose products with no additional allergenic ingredients beyond the warnings listed here; otherwise these ingredient-based recommendations no longer apply. Listed tags apply only to the specified ingredients; they are not allergy-safe guarantees.
  • Refrigerate perishable ingredients until needed. Refrigerate leftovers in shallow containers within 2 hours (within 1 hour above 90°F/32°C); reheat leftovers to 74°C/165°F.

Ingredients

  • 1/2 cup dry quinoa (Rinsed. Check package labels; use the specified dietary version and check additional allergens and cross-contact notices.)
  • 1 cup water
  • 1 1/2 cups canned chickpeas (Drained and rinsed; quantities are drained. Check package labels; use the specified dietary version and check additional allergens and cross-contact notices.)
  • 1/2 medium cucumber (diced)
  • 1 medium tomatoes (diced)
  • 1/3 cup fresh parsley (chopped)
  • 2 tablespoons lemon juice
  • 1 tablespoon olive oil

Cooking instructions

  1. Bring the dry quinoa and water to a boil. Cover, cook on low for 15 minutes, then rest off heat for 5 minutes.
  2. While it cooks, whisk the lemon juice and olive oil in a large bowl and fold in the canned chickpeas, cucumber, tomatoes and fresh parsley.
  3. Fluff the quinoa, spread on a clean plate for 2 minutes to release steam, then fold into the salad.
  4. Serve slightly warm immediately, or refrigerate in shallow covered containers promptly for a cold salad later.
